## 💡 Problem Statement

A clear description of the problem you're trying to solve.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## 🎯 Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📸 Mockups / Examples

If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or examples from other tools.

## 🎯 Use Case

Describe the use case — who benefits and how?

Example: "As a podcast editor, I want to separate voice from background music so that I can clean up interviews."

## 📋 Additional Context

Add any other context, links, or screenshots about the feature request here.
